united-arab-emirates.scope: Tourist travel; passport and residence determine the available entry route.
united-arab-emirates.summary: A tourist visa is a route for travellers who are not eligible for visa-free entry or visa on arrival. Check your passport-specific route before paying for an application.
united-arab-emirates.type: Tourist visa; route depends on eligibility
united-arab-emirates.validity: As stated on the issued visa
checklist: For Dubai single-entry tourist applications, GDRFA lists a personal photograph and passport copy.
Some nationalities require an additional national identity document.
GCC residents use a separate route: check passport and residence-permit requirements.
steps: Check entry eligibility through the UAE government portal.
Confirm the relevant tourism or GCC-resident application route before preparing documents.

schengen-area.scope: General short-stay applications; local consulates may require additional evidence.
schengen-area.summary: For a short Schengen visit, apply through the competent consulate and check the permitted stay on your visa. A short stay is normally limited to 90 days in any 180-day period; visa validity is not an automatic right to spend that entire period in the area.
schengen-area.validity: Permitted stay on issued visa; 90/180 rule applies
schengen-area.processing: Normally 15 days; may extend to 45 days
checklist: Passport valid at least three months after planned departure from the Schengen area.
Application form, compliant photograph and medical travel insurance.
Evidence of travel purpose, accommodation, financial means and intention to return.
Fingerprints are normally collected; exemptions exist.
steps: Submit no earlier than six months before travel and at least 15 days before the journey.
Check the consulate’s appointment procedure and additional requirements.
schengen-area.fees: Standard official fees are EUR 90 for adults and EUR 45 for children aged 6–12; exceptions and waivers apply. Application-centre and RAAHHI service charges are separate.

sources.name: European Commission: applying for a Schengen visa

united-states.scope: Temporary B-1 business/B-2 tourism visits; follow the embassy handling your application.
united-states.summary: A B-1/B-2 visitor application is different from permission to work or immigrate. The consular officer decides whether you qualify; a visa does not guarantee admission.
united-states.validity: Visa validity and permitted stay are separate decisions
united-states.processing: Appointment and case dependent; no fixed deadline
checklist: Passport valid for US travel, subject to the applicable validity rules.
DS-160 confirmation, compliant photograph and fee receipt where required.
Additional evidence may be requested about the purpose of travel, your intention to leave and ability to pay.
steps: Complete the DS-160 and retain the confirmation/barcode page.
Follow the relevant embassy’s fee and interview instructions; interview-waiver eligibility is case specific.

sources.name: US Department of State: visitor visa

singapore.scope: The checklist below is for Indian travel-document holders applying for business or social visits. Other nationalities must use their own ICA guidance.
singapore.summary: Indian passport holders should follow ICA’s India-specific entry-visa instructions. The visa and permission to enter are separate; each application is considered on its merits.
singapore.type: Entry visa, where required for your travel document
singapore.validity: As granted; check the authorised stay separately
singapore.processing: Usually three working days, excluding submission day; some take longer
checklist: Completed, signed Form 14A.
Recent colour photograph taken within the last three months.
Passport biodata copy; passport valid for at least six months from entry.
A letter of introduction or other supporting documents may be requested.
steps: Applications can use a local contact or strategic partner in Singapore, or an overseas mission/its authorised agent.
ICA advises applying within 30 days before arrival. Check the mission’s procedure.
singapore.fees: ICA lists a non-refundable SGD 30 processing fee. Service charges are additional and confirmed in your quotation.

sources.name: Singapore ICA: check your travel document

united-kingdom.scope: Standard Visitor applications from outside the UK; passport-specific visa or ETA requirements must be checked first.
united-kingdom.summary: Depending on your nationality, a UK visit may require a visa or an electronic travel authorisation. Check the official route before starting a Standard Visitor application. A longer-validity visa does not permit a continuous stay for that entire period.
united-kingdom.validity: Usually up to six months per visit; follow visa conditions
united-kingdom.processing: Usually three weeks after identity and document requirements; may take longer
checklist: Valid passport or travel document.
Details of the trip, its cost, your accommodation and how it will be funded.
Supporting evidence appropriate to your visit and personal circumstances.
steps: Where a visa is required, apply online before travel and attend the required application-centre appointment.
The earliest application is three months before travel. Follow the official document checklist.

sources.name: GOV.UK: apply for a Standard Visitor visa
GOV.UK: check if you need a visa

saudi-arabia.scope: Tourism entry routes; eligibility depends on your passport and other qualifying circumstances.
saudi-arabia.summary: The official Saudi tourist eVisa is available to eligible travellers. Do not assume that residence in another country automatically makes a passport eligible. Use the official eligibility route for your circumstances.
saudi-arabia.type: Tourist visa; eligible route confirmed per traveller
saudi-arabia.validity: Eligible tourist eVisa: one-year multiple entry, up to 90 days
saudi-arabia.processing: Confirmed for the eligible application route
checklist: Passport meeting the applicable route’s validity requirement; the eVisa terms specify at least six months from entry.
Photograph meeting the official specifications.
Confirm eligibility before application or fee payment.
steps: Check the official tourism portal’s eligibility guidance.
If you cannot use the eVisa route, check the appropriate consular route. Tourist permissions do not cover work or Hajj.

sources.name: Saudi eVisa: conditions and passport rules

canada.scope: Temporary visitor applications; the required route and evidence depend on the reason for travel.
canada.summary: IRCC’s visitor application route and document checklist depend on why you are travelling. Use the personalised checklist in the application portal rather than assume one list covers every traveller.
canada.validity: As issued; permitted admission is decided separately
checklist: Travel document and identity information required by the portal.
Documents supporting your reason for visiting and circumstances, as listed in your personalised checklist.
Biometrics if required; follow the instruction letter and official collection procedure.
steps: Choose the correct visitor purpose on the official IRCC application page.
Apply using the applicable online portal and follow any additional document or biometric requests.

sources.name: IRCC: apply for a visitor visa

thailand.scope: Tourist eVisa preparation; visa exemption and application eligibility depend on your travel document and circumstances.
thailand.summary: Check whether you need a tourist visa before applying. The Thai Ministry of Foreign Affairs operates the official eVisa portal; an application is not a guarantee of approval.
thailand.type: Tourist visa or other eligible entry route
thailand.validity: As granted for the selected visa route
thailand.processing: Depends on the responsible mission and application
checklist: Passport or travel-document biodata page.
Photograph taken within the last six months.
Evidence of current location, such as a valid visa or residence document, as applicable.
Any additional evidence requested for your selected tourist route.
steps: Use the official Thai eVisa portal and choose the route relevant to your circumstances.
Follow the responsible mission’s instructions and retain the approval confirmation if issued.

sources.name: Thai Ministry of Foreign Affairs: tourist eVisa
